titulo: Quiz — How they talk when it isn't to you
subtitulo: Fast speech and the five fillers
introPt: A traveller follows the shape of a conversation without catching every word.
cenario: Two people talking at native speed.

dialogo.es: Ma non lo so, te l'ho già detto!
dialogo.pt: But I don't know, I already told you!
dialogo.tts: Ma non lo so, te l'ho già detto!

dialogo.pt: Dunno, well, we'll see. Maybe tomorrow.

dialogo.es: Allora, facciamo così: io vado, tu resti.
dialogo.pt: Right then, let's do this: I go, you stay.
dialogo.tts: Allora, facciamo così: io vado, tu resti.

dialogo.es: Eh sì, esatto, appunto, dicevo io la stessa cosa!
dialogo.pt: Yes exactly, precisely, I was saying the same thing!
dialogo.tts: Eh sì, esatto, appunto, dicevo io la stessa cosa!

opcoes: I have no idea - a complete answer
perguntas.explica: Do not wait for more after it.

perguntas.pergunta: Allora at the start of a sentence signals:
perguntas.explica: Pay attention to what follows it.

perguntas.pergunta: Two people talking over each other loudly are usually:
perguntas.explica: Esatto, appunto, infatti are agreement words.

perguntas.pergunta: Non lo so in fast speech:
perguntas.explica: That is not sloppy - it is what the language sounds like.

perguntas.pergunta: Should you use dai and guagliò yourself?
opcoes: No - this module is receptive; it lands as performative
perguntas.explica: Recognise it; do not deploy it.
